Monster Gallery

Monster Gallery

Section titled “Monster Gallery”

All 204 distinct monster sprites from bcdfb through bcdfn, grouped by creature. Each card cycles through that creature’s stored size/depth ladder; hover a card to pause it. The confirmed names come from the game’s manual, clue book, ending text, or DOS archive. The remaining entries retain their map/creature labels instead of being given invented names.
